inputs.checklistItemText: Trees not shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities, preventing clearance verification
inputs.question: On Sheet 9 (Site Plan), are overhead electric distribution or transmission lines shown? If yes, describe their location, configuration (poles, conductors), and whether they cross the site or run along property boundaries.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking about the presence and spatial configuration of overhead electric lines on the site plan (location, poles, conductors, crossing/boundary relationship), which requires reasoning about lines, symbols, and spatial relationships in the drawing—not a measurement or simple presence check. This is sub-feature identification and drawing-element reasoning that precedes any clearance measurement.
